title: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.105.0, contain an Improper… (CVE-2026-111515)
description: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC) versions prior to 6.14.105.0 have an improper authorization vulnerability in the handler for a custom URL scheme. This flaw allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to potentially execute commands and launch phishing attacks. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.1.
